## Problem
`gate-manifest record spec-approval` checks only JSON syntax before appending to `.adlc/manifest.jsonl`, allowing invalid `spec-approval` records (missing/empty `sources`, `rounds < 1`, `questions < 1`, `unresolved !== 0`, wrong `--files` count, mismatched `spec_hash`, or missing/newer `spec-lint` and `premortem` records) that `adlc run p1` later rejects (#1181).

## Solution
1. Create `packages/gate-manifest/lib/spec-approval.mjs` exporting `validateSpecApprovalRecord({ data, files, entries = [], cwd = process.cwd() })` and `specApprovalIntegrityErrors(entries, { cwd = process.cwd() } = {})` with the exact P1 validation messages.
2. Re-export `validateSpecApprovalRecord` and `specApprovalIntegrityErrors` from `packages/gate-manifest/index.mjs` and `packages/runner/lib/assertions.mjs`.
3. In `packages/gate-manifest/bin/gate-manifest.mjs`, add `--force` to `KNOWN_FLAGS` and `BOOLEAN_FLAGS` and, when `verb === "record" && gate === "spec-approval" && !flags.force`, validate the candidate record against `readManifest(dir)` before calling `record()`, failing with `opError` (exit 1) and leaving `.adlc/manifest.jsonl` untouched on any error.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: `gate-manifest record spec-approval` rejects empty `sources`, `rounds < 1`, `questions < 1`, `unresolved !== 0`, `files.length !== 1`, mismatched `spec_hash`, or missing/newer `spec-lint`/`premortem` with exit 1 and does not modify `.adlc/manifest.jsonl`.
- AC2: Passing `--force` bypasses the `spec-approval` pre-record check, and a valid `spec-approval` record succeeds and passes `adlc run p1`.
- AC3: `@adlc/runner` (`packages/runner/lib/assertions.mjs`) and `@adlc/gate-manifest` share the validator.
title: gate-manifest: validate spec-approval payloads and prerequisites before recording (#1181)
